entries.message: The core spells each limit, document depth, stored key and web scheme once, on the type that owns it.
The contract generator reads a record's identity from its own fact, and the core reads the 2001 reference date from the session codec everywhere.
The core takes the time from the turn or its clock everywhere, so tests can set it.
Closing and deleting tabs, the Spaces being deleted, and numbered Sub-Space names each follow one rule in the core.
Each crest figure kind reads and writes its own stored form.
Asking whether the core would take an action accepts only session intents, so the type says what the check covers.
Page resource kinds carry the request kind the content filter matches, and the filter library's saved state has one codec.
Two lone rejections join their concept files, the capacity limits file takes its record's name, and the palette's layout and source sets get files of their own.
Core rules ask a tab section for the fact they mean, such as whether it outlives the session, instead of naming the section.
